lang.title: Choose your language
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.session_ended: Your session ended, so protection is paused. Sign in again to switch it back on.
phone.title: Your phone number
phone.help: We send a code to your Telegram to check it is really you. We do not share your number.
phone.invalid: That doesn't look like a phone number. Check it and try again.
otp.title: Enter the 6-digit code
otp.format: The code is 6 numbers. Check it and try again.
otp.invalid: That code is not the newest one. Ask Telegram for a new code and type the latest one.
contacts.title: Emergency contacts
contacts.help: These people get your alerts. Every alert rings on their phone and keeps ringing until it is attended to.
contacts.invalid: Check the phone numbers. Each one must be valid and different.
pins.title: Your safety PIN
pins.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
pins.must_differ: The two PINs must be different.
perm.title: Make Sentri work when your phone is locked
perm.battery: Do not let the phone stop Sentri in the background
home.hero: One hidden move. Your people already know where.
home.check_sub: Before you set out, choose the time your contacts should check on you. If you do not mark yourself safe by then, they get a full alert.
home.check_until: If you're not safe by {time}, an alert goes to your contacts.
triggers.title: Ways to call for help
triggers.power_note: Best effort: does not work on every phone brand.
sos.active: Alert is active. Your location is being shared.
sos.offline: No connection. Your alert is saved and goes out the moment you're online.
sos.responding: A contact is responding. Stay safe.
sos.locked: Too many tries. Try again later.
sos.contacts_busy: Contacts cannot be changed while an alert is active.
health.heart_none: No heart-rate source on this phone yet. Connect a health app or band that saves heart rate to Health Connect, and it will show here.
health.heart_perm: Sentri is waiting for your permission to read heart-rate records. Tap the button below.
health.heart_base: Your usual resting rate: {n} bpm. I am watching quietly for a strange climb.
health.heart_watch: I will quietly tell you if it climbs strangely.
health.hr_alert_body: {n} bpm just now. Sit down and rest for a moment. If it stays high after resting, use your emergency help.
health.water_sub: Gentle reminders at the pace you choose. Pick one below and the phone does the rest.
health.water_body: A few sips now keeps you steady through the day.
health.hosp_error: The map service is answering slowly right now. We keep trying in the background; check your data connection, or tap Try again.
health.hosp_none: No hospital has a phone number saved nearby yet.
health.hosp_no_phone: No phone number saved on the map yet
health.heart_cam: The app reads your pulse itself: press a fingertip gently over the front camera, at the top of the screen, then tap the button below. No health app needed.
health.measure_nofeed: The camera did not send any picture. Make sure the screen is bright, you are not on a call, and try again.
health.measure_tip: Press your fingertip over the front camera at the top of the screen until it fully covers it. Keep the phone facing you, screen bright, hand still - the bright screen lights the reading.
health.measure_fail: That reading was not strong enough. Press the fingertip firmly over the lens, sit still, and try again.
health.measure_no_cam: No working camera, or the camera permission was not given. Check the camera permission and try again.
health.hosp_location: We could not get your location yet. Turn on location, step outside or near a window, and open this tab again.
map.unknown_place: Finding the name of this place...
map.route_failed: Couldn't plan this trip right now. Check your data, then tap Retry.
map.route_fix_gps: Still finding your exact spot. Turn your GPS on, then tap Retry.
map.approx_hint: Your phone is giving an approximate position. For an exact one: turn on GPS, set Sentri's location to Precise, and go outside or near a window.
map.no_location: Turn on location to see where you are.
map.pick_hint: Tap and hold a spot on the map.
map.nearby_none: No named places within a short walk. The map itself shows small streets and shops.
map.search_empty: Type a place, a street or a business.
map.search_no_results: No place found. Check the spelling or try a nearby town.
map.search_none_near: Not mapped near you yet. Try the next street, or long-press the map to point at it.
police.note: Official Nigeria Police Force lines for every state and the FCT. If a line doesn't pick up, call 112.
contacts.declined_note: A contact declined. Add someone else so at least three people can help.
contacts.load_failed: Could not load your contacts. Check your connection.
contacts.characters: Tap a contact to give them their own name and pick one of 20 friendly security characters. Names and characters are saved on this phone only.
inbox.title: Messages
inbox.none: Nothing here yet. Alerts from people who chose you will show up here.
inbox.need_signin: Your session ended, so messages can't load right now. Sign in again to bring them back.
inbox.failed: Couldn't load messages. Pull down to try again.
inbox.invite_text: {n} added you as an emergency contact.
inbox.scam_note: Sentri never texts you an alert or a link. A text that says it's from Sentri is fake.
inbox.test_sent: Test sent to {n} of your contacts.
inbox.test_none: None of your contacts have Sentri yet.
inbox.test_wait: You can send another test in a few minutes.
share.title: Share location
share.help: Choose who can follow you live. They're alerted when you start and when you stop.
share.limit_note: Sharing ends by itself at the end of this time, so it can't be left on by mistake.
share.live_note: Your contacts were alerted. They'll be alerted again when you stop.
share.invite_text: I added you as my emergency contact on Sentri. Install the app so I can alert you if I'm ever in danger.
share.none_reachable: None of those people have Sentri yet.
share.stop_pending: Stopping. This finishes as soon as you're back online.
contacts.app_only: Alerts reach contacts inside the app, with a ringing notification. People without Sentri can't be alerted, so invite them.
police.approx: Closest command to this position, picked by distance. These are the Nigeria Police Force's official lines. If one doesn't pick up, call 112.
police.cant_dial: Couldn't open the phone app. Dial the number by hand.
police.none_found: No police numbers found for this area.
police.waiting: Waiting for a location fix. You can still call 112.
otp.send_failed: We couldn't send the code. Check the number and try again in a moment.
otp.too_many: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
otp.test_code: Test mode: your code is {code}. Tap to fill it in.
otp.telegram_sent: Get your code for {phone} on Telegram.
otp.telegram_hint: In Telegram, tap Start, then Share my number. Your code arrives in that chat. Come back here and type it.
sos.police_note: Need the police? Call 112 or the nearest line below.
